lifecycles._note: COVERAGE-ONLY guarded lifecycle for the cachestore (Redis) DBaaS cluster sub-op WRITE endpoints. Soft-captures an existing cluster_id (+ instance_group_id/bsg_id) from read-only calls; absent that, tokens normalize to the catalog '*' key so every endpoint is CALLED+RECORDED (4xx counts). All mutating steps optional+grouped+broad-expect_status; heavy:true (SCP_RUN_HEAVY); DELETEs destructive:true. Bodies from api_docs request_example, UNPROVEN. cachestore DIVERGES MOST from the relational template: it uses commands (PUT /commands with {id,name,new_value}) + commands/sync INSTEAD of the full archive/audit/log-export surface, has NO archive/audit-log/log-export/replicas/promote/databases/add-secondary, no add-block-storages, patch body uses dbaas_engine+software_version (filled with the userguide-documented Redis OSS Sentinel 7.2.11 — knowledge/formal/services/database__cachestore.yaml), backup body omits archive_frequency_minute, and restore wants explicit OS+DATA block_storage_groups. remove-backup-histories 401s with valid HMAC (backend quirk, run 27258520218).

lifecycles._note: COVERAGE-ONLY read lifecycle for cachestore id-bound GETs. Soft-captures an existing cluster_id (from /v1/clusters) and dbaas_engine_version_id (from /v1/engine-versions), then a probe_reads step exercises EVERY cachestore catalog GET whose path params are satisfied (commands via cluster_id, engine-version properties via dbaas_engine_version_id, requests via a literal placeholder request_id) so each id-bound GET is CALLED and RECORDED under its own catalog key (a 4xx counts as covered). 100% read-only: every step optional + grouped, broad expect_status. requests/{request_id} is KNOWN-HARD: request_id is returned only by async ops and is not listable, so a literal placeholder id is used purely so the endpoint is reached (4xx expected).

MinorPatchDbEngineRequest body CONFIRMED via data/api_docs.json (database/cachestore/minorpatchdbenginerequest): {dbaas_engine string REQUIRED, software_version string REQUIRED} -- ONLY 2 fields, NO backup_before_upgrade (unlike mysql/mariadb's sibling MinorPatchRequest model, which DOES require it) -- do not port that field over by analogy. dbaas_engine is captured LIVE from the cluster's own detail GET ($.dbaas_engine) so it reflects whatever the backend actually reports (a690 2026-07-16 found this now reports 'Valkey Sentinel', not 'redis'/'Redis OSS Sentinel' -- the OLD hardcoded patch body in cachestore-cluster-subops-guarded is doubly stale: wrong engine name AND a software_version no longer in the catalog). cachestoreshowinstance needs instance_name (a NAME not an id) captured from $.instance_groups[0].instances[0].name on the cluster detail. cachestoreremovebackuphistories/cachestoreunsetbackup are RE-TESTED here for a fresh cachestore confirmation of the known cross-engine 401 Dbaas.Unauthorized.AuthNFailed-with-valid-HMAC PF quirk (mysql/mariadb/postgresql/epas/cachestore all show it on PUT .../backup-histories + DELETE .../backups per knowledge/validated-facts.md and cachestore-cluster-subops-a's 2026-07-04/2026-07-16 notes) -- widened expect_status tolerates it without cascading a group-skip. cachestorecreaterestore and cachestoreswitchovercluster are DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED (cost/design deferral, not attempted): create-restore provisions an ADDITIONAL untracked billable cluster with no capture/cleanup path in this lifecycle shape; switchover's RedisSwitchoverTargetRequest needs switch_host_name from a SECOND live host, which only exists on an ha_enabled=true cluster (this lifecycle is single-node, matching the existing subops-a/b non-HA design) -- both stay classified blockers/next_levers, not chased with a second billable cluster in this session. Own dedicated VPC/subnet (10.151.0.0/20) so this never contends with cachestore-cluster-subops-a/b's 10.134/10.136 ranges or other concurrent DBaaS agents' 10.13x/10.14x ranges.
